messages.text: BL-1769 🎵 in progress — qa-gather builds its register join from the 4000-char display excerpt of a red unit or property run, so when the tail is stderr noise (BL-871 onTaskUpdate timeouts) the FAIL line is cut off and the join comes back empty - read as no failing file - which left the red UNIDENTIFIED and its parcel held twice (BL-1726 QA 2026-09-25, BL-1766 QA 2026-09-26): the join reads the whole output, and a red suite it still cannot attribute is listed unidentified, never omitted
